status_detail: City of Chaska says preliminary site plan/plat was approved by Planning Commission and City Council in October 2024; final application has not been submitted and power-system impact study remains a gating item.
notes: Official city page lists developer, 2007 Schoolmaster Dr. location, and approximately 1.5 million sq ft project in West Creek Corporate Center. CloudHQ markets the MSP campus as up to 200 MW critical IT load; older trade coverage reported 180 MW/72 acres.

status_detail: Operator markets an active Chaska data center; 2024 spec sheet lists 160,838 sq ft footprint and 9 MW critical load UPS capacity.
notes: Located in Chaska, MN; operator materials describe Generation 4 purpose-built facility, high-density capacity, compliance certifications, and colocation/cloud services.

project_name: Stream Data Centers Minneapolis II / U.S. Bank Chaska
status_detail: Announced in 2017 as a $250 million U.S. Bank data center in partnership with Stream Data Centers, expected to complete in early 2018; later reporting says the Chaska facility housed part of U.S. Bank's server network.
notes: Minnesota Governor/DEED archived release gives official project details: about 56,000 sq ft, 18 permanent jobs, Job Creation Fund support, and City of Chaska tax abatement. Stream describes its second Chaska facility as a ground-up build-to-suit for a large commercial bank.

status_detail: Stream's Chaska campus page says it delivered a turnkey colocation facility; 2013 trade coverage said Stream was building a 75,675 sq ft Chaska facility to be ready in 2014, and DCD reported 2.4 MW IT load.
notes: Likely part of Stream's Chaska campus near West Creek Lane; capacity from trade coverage, not county/city records.

status_detail: Reported as a UnitedHealth/Optum enterprise data center in Chaska's West Creek Corporate Park; opened around 2012 according to later Minnesota reporting.
notes: Older news said UnitedHealth planned a 190,000 sq ft data center in Chaska; Star Tribune later described the West Creek business park facility as 250,000 sq ft used by UnitedHealth Group and opened in 2012. Job posting evidence confirms Optum/UnitedHealth data center operations in Chaska.

status_detail: LightEdge announced acquisition of a 76,000 sq ft, 3.6 MW Tier III Design Certified Chaska data center in January 2024, with immediate capacity available.
notes: May overlap historically with a prior Stream/private facility in Chaska; kept as a separate current operator record because LightEdge announced ownership and operation.
